name: pi-pixie
description: Pixie delegation & command console plugin (dispatch/report/ask/name/recall/sessions/status/interject/stop/retry): talks to the PiAbyss Host loopback control plane; the delegation engine stays Host-side. Segments are created only when the user starts a new session in the UI; the newest-created session in the pixie workspace is the current segment (no naps, no handoff summaries, no automatic switching). Segment memory is plugin-side: the first turn of a new segment gets an index of past segments plus the previous segment's tail, read straight from Pi's session directory, and pixie_recall reads older segments on demand. Dispatch carries the dispatching session's own sourceSessionId so the Host can route the report back, plus optional taskName/sessionName short names; pixie_name renames the current segment.
author: Nick12138
